steps.note: exchange up to 4,000 per person with proof of identity
limit raised to 4,500, immediate effect; separate queues
indelible ink on the right index finger, metro cities first
no exchange at bank counters after midnight of 2016-11-24

criteria.detail: Stated total against exchange plus deposits: up to 2016-11-18 total 544571, parts 544571, residue 0; up to 2016-11-27 total 844982, parts 844981, residue 1 (crore). Each figure is rounded to a crore, so a residue of one is the format.
criteria.name: B160-1

criteria.detail: The banks' daily report (circular DCM 1264, 2016-11-11, Annex 6 and 6A) has the rows 'Exchanged in Cash' and 'Deposits into Account'; the two releases print 'exchange amounted to' and 'deposits amounted to' and name the counters of the Reserve Bank and the banks. The release words are the report rows. Phrases: c10698 'Exchanged in Cash' True, c10698 'Deposits into Account' True, pr38643 'exchange amounted to' True, pr38727 'deposits amounted to' True.
criteria.name: B160-2

criteria.detail: Pages read: 740 press releases (prid 38520-39259, 2016-11-08 to 2017-01) and 110 circulars (Id 10670-10779); 78 concern the withdrawn notes; those that print exchange and deposits apart: [38643, 38727]. Later releases print other objects: pr38839 2016-12-08 activity at banks, 2016-11-10 to 12-07: issuance only; pr38886 2016-12-13 deputy governors' briefing: notes returned to RBI and chests; pr38980 2016-12-21 distribution of banknotes: issuance only; pr39163 2017-01-05 clarification: periodic SBN figures are chest accounting entries. The banks reported daily (Annex 6A); only two cumulative points were published, so the daily shape is not readable and the reading is two segments.
criteria.name: B160-3

criteria.detail: 2016-11-10 to 2016-11-18 (9 days): exchange 33006 crore (3667.3 a day), deposits 511565 crore (56840.6 a day); days by regime: 3 under cap 4000, no ink, bank and Reserve Bank counters, 2 under cap 4500, no ink, bank and Reserve Bank counters, 3 under cap 4500, ink, bank and Reserve Bank counters, 1 under cap 2000, ink, bank and Reserve Bank counters | 2016-11-19 to 2016-11-27 (9 days): exchange 942 crore (104.7 a day), deposits 299468 crore (33274.2 a day); days by regime: 6 under cap 2000, ink, bank and Reserve Bank counters, 3 under cap 2000, ink, Reserve Bank counters only. The cap moved in four steps and the ink came in between; both segments hold more than one regime, so the fall belongs to the steps together and is not split among them.
criteria.name: B160-4

criteria.detail: Daily exchange fell by a factor 35.0382 (crore rounding moves it within 35.0191 to 35.0574). The amount per counter event can fall at most from the first segment's top cap (4500) to one 500 note, a factor 9.0000; so the number of counter events fell at least 3.8931-fold. If everyone exchanged the cap in force and the first segment's flow came on its 4,000 and 4,500 days, events fell 15.5725 to 17.5191-fold. Events: first segment 7.3347 to 66.0120 crore, second 0.4710 to 1.8840 crore. The narrowing worked mainly on who got through, not on how much each one carried.
criteria.name: B160-5

criteria.detail: Exchange share of notes tendered: 0.060609 then 0.003136. Deposits' own daily flow fell too (second over first 0.5854): cumulative deposits rose, the flow did not. Had exchange fallen like deposits it would have been 19321.6 crore; the shortfall 18379.6 crore is 0.061374 of second-segment deposits. Whether that shortfall went into deposits cannot be separated from the general slowing of tenders. Withdrawals: 103316 then 113301 crore.
criteria.name: B160-6
